description: Implementation of a service class for sending emails with attachments within the Fineract project, utilizing JavaMailSender and configuration data.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobEmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class responsible for sending emails with attachments, configured via SMTP settings retrieved from configuration data.

methods.name: sendEmailWithAttachment
methods.description: Sends an email with optional attachment using SMTP configuration retrieved from the platform service.

methods.name: getJavaMailProperties
methods.description: Constructs JavaMail properties including SMTP authentication, TLS, and server trust settings.

methods.name: getReportMailingJobConfigurationData
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration data object by name from a collection.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpServer
methods.description: Returns the SMTP server name for Gmail from configuration data.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpPort
methods.description: Returns the SMTP port number for Gmail from configuration data.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpUsername
methods.description: Returns the SMTP username for Gmail from configuration data.

methods.name: getGmailSmtpPassword
methods.description: Returns the SMTP password for Gmail from configuration data.
